correctness.rationale: The gnomonic parameterization (1,u,v)/√(1+u²+v²), u,v∈[-1,1], supplies area density (1+u²+v²)^−3/2 and fourth-moment kernel exponent −7/2. Reflection and y↔z exchange diagonalize the five pure H2 sectors Q0=3x²−1,xy,xz,y²−z²,yz. Four exact relations A−3B=T1, 3B−2C+3E=T1, B+C−4E=T3 and A+4B+2C+2E=2π/3 with T1=8√3/27,T3=2√3/27 yield A=2π/15+52√3/135, B=2π/45+4√3/135, C=2π/15−26√3/135, E=2π/45−8√3/135. Dividing local sector norms (3A−12B+Ω, B, B, 2(C−E), E) by full sphere norms (16π/5,4π/15,4π/15,16π/15,4π/15) gives exactly all four positive ordered levels; strict level gaps yield uniqueness of extremizers. Independent exact SymPy solution and eigenvalues reproduced.

value.rationale: An exact sharp bandlimited regional concentration operator on the fundamental cubed-sphere face is a natural concrete Slepian benchmark, with exact extremizing degree-two modes and energy condition ratio for face-localized spherical analysis; it provides independently useful constants not determined by the generic eigensolver framework.

final_claim: For one cubed-sphere face R={x≥|y|,x≥|z|} and pure degree-two spherical harmonics, the 5 eigenvalues (multiplicities 1,2,1,1) are 1/6+√3/(4π), 1/6+√3/(9π), 1/6−2√3/(9π), 1/6−√3/(4π), with sharp max/min eigenvectors 3x²−1 and y²−z² and ratio (2π+3√3)/(2π−3√3).
limitations: Pure homogeneous harmonic degree two on one cube face with ordinary sphere area, no full lower-degree band, higher degrees, node sampling or arbitrary-area weights.
residual_risks: An older specialist cubed-sphere moment table may permit direct extraction of these eigenvalues; no exhaustive historical database search.
The exact result concerns pure H2 only, not full bandwidth L≤2, where degree mixing would alter the spectrum.
